info.title: OMS New Object Template Service
info.description: The New Object Template API enables users to manage object templates used during object creation and processing. With this API, you can add, change, copy and delete object templates.

port.description: The port to which the server is listening.

/add.description: Adds a new object template for the specified application. The template is created with the provided template details and is available for object processing.

post.description: Adds a new object template with the specified attributes. DescriptionType is a mandatory field, while other fields use their default values where applicable.

ObjectAddRequest.summary: How to add and Object Template for template type OBJECT.

MessageAddRequest.summary: How to add and Object Template for template type Message.

SourceAddRequest.summary: How to add and Object Template for template type SRCMEMBER.

addResponse200.summary: Response to a successful API call

message.messageText:
Action *ADD for object template Object Template REST API completed normally. 
Cause . . . . . :   Action *ADD for object template Object Template REST API completed normally.
Recovery  . . . :   None needed, this message is informational.

/change.description: Changes an existing object template for the specified application. The template is updated with the provided template details and is available for object processing.

post.description: Changes an existing object template with the specified attributes. DescriptionType is a mandatory field, while other fields use their default values where applicable.

ObjectChangeRequest.summary: How to change and Object Template for template type OBJECT.

MessageChangeRequest.summary: How to change and Object Template for template type Message.

SourceChangeRequest.summary: How to change and Object Template for template type SRCMEMBER.

message.messageText:
Action *CHANGE for object template Object Template REST API completed normally. 
Cause . . . . . :   Action *ADD for object template Object Template REST API completed normally.
Recovery  . . . :   None needed, this message is informational.

/copy.description: Copies an existing object template for the specified application. The template is copied with the provided template details and is available for object processing.

post.description: Copies an existing object template with the specified attributes. DescriptionType and NewDescription are mandatory fields, while other fields use their default values where applicable.

ObjectCopyRequest.summary: How to copy and Object Template for template type OBJECT.

MessageChangeRequest.summary: How to copy and Object Template for template type Message.

SourceChangeRequest.summary: How to copy and Object Template for template type SRCMEMBER.

copyResponse200.summary: Response to a successful API call

message.messageText:
Action *COPY for object template Object Template REST API completed normally. 
Cause . . . . . :   Action *ADD for object template Object Template REST API completed normally.
Recovery  . . . :   None needed, this message is informational.

/delete.description: Deletes an existing object template for the specified application. The template is removed and is no longer available for object processing.

post.description: Deletes an existing object template with the specified attributes. DescriptionType is a mandatory field, while other fields use their default values where applicable.

DeleteRequest.summary: How to delete an Object Template.

deleteResponse200.summary: Response to a successful API call

Interface level V19R0M0 not supported for OMQCHGNT. 
Cause . . . . . :   Your request to the OMS application program interface OMQCHGNT has been denied because the interface level V19R0M0 is not valid or not supported.
Recovery  . . . :   Enter a valid interface level in the format VxRyMz (E.g. V3R0M0). Check the OMS documentation for the correct parameter description and supported interface levels.

templateType.description: Specify the type of template. Use *Object for an object template, *Srcmember for a source member template, or *Message for a message template.
